import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
test('the engine unit', async (t) => {
  const booted = existsSync('/run/systemd/system');
  await t.test('restarts after a crash', { todo: !booted && 'needs systemd' }, () => {
    if (!booted) throw new Error('no systemd here');
  });
});
